_comment: Real availability/map responses recorded 2026-11-03 for the campground types the first fixtures didn't cover: cabins (booking category 5), shelters (7) and Chilkoot Trail campgrounds (17), each for 3 nights about 10 days out and in July 2027, party of 2. Every request was accepted; none showed the site available (2 = not operating, 3 = not released), which is why cabins and shelters stay off alerts (app/backcountry/alertable.py). Riding Mountain's cabin is 3 while its map shows 0.
